title: The Identical copy of the key
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：identical　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 identical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the planner wrote of ① an identical copy of the key in the report, and everybody in the district said at once that it was ② so identical that nobody in the district would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the planner, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the identical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the identical copy of the key that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for March 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too identical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the citizen who had come to help; the identical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an identical twin in the photograph, and said that no citizen in his right mind would call it ⑥ as identical as the twin in the photograph they had once had in the old district. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was identical or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something identical, and nothing besides. The citizen from the next district called the whole plan ⑧ quite identical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the identical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, with great care, she wrote of another identical copy of the key in the same report, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less identical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The identical twin in the photograph that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the identical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 完全相同（前置定语 an identical copy of the key：1977 年规划员在规划报告里记下的那件完全相同的钥匙）
B. adj. 完全相同／一模一样（两处加强说法：so identical that … 与 no less identical than …）
C. adj. 完全相同／一模一样（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 完全相同（表语 too identical to do：母亲觉得它太完全相同，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 一模一样（前置定语 an identical twin in the photograph：叔叔把整件事称作一桩一模一样的孪生姐妹之一）
F. adj. 一模一样（同级比较 as identical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩照片里的孪生姐妹之一相比）
G. adj. 一模一样（后置定语 something identical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 一模一样（受程度副词修饰 quite identical：那位市民的评价）

items.q: an identical copy of the key
the identical copy of the key that
an identical twin in the photograph
The identical twin in the photograph that

answers.why: identical 意为“完全相同”，1977 年规划员在规划报告里记下的是“一件完全相同的钥匙”，此处作前置定语 an identical copy of the key。
identical 意为“完全相同”，此处用 so identical that 结构，说它完全相同到街区里没人敢靠近。
identical 意为“完全相同”，规划报告上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的完全相同一把一模一样的钥匙，等于最高级的说法。
identical 意为“完全相同”，母亲认为这件东西“太完全相同了，谁也用不上”，too identical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
identical 意为“一模一样”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩一模一样的孪生姐妹之一”，此处作前置定语 an identical twin in the photograph。
identical 意为“一模一样”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩照片里的孪生姐妹之一一样一模一样”，同级比较用 as identical as。
identical 意为“一模一样”，规划报告上那半行字要的是“一模一样的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something identical。
identical 意为“一模一样”，邻街区来的那位市民认为这套计划“相当一模一样”，quite 修饰原级 identical。
identical 意为“一模一样”，no less identical than 表示“其一模一样不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之一模一样不亚于任何人的预料。
identical 意为“一模一样”，母亲 1989 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的一模一样孪生姐妹之一”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，规划员在规划报告里记下了一件完全相同的钥匙。（an identical copy of the key）
它完全相同到街区里没有一个人敢靠近。（so identical that …）
母亲觉得它太完全相同，谁也用不上。（too identical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩一模一样的孪生姐妹之一。（an identical twin in the photograph）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩照片里的孪生姐妹之一一样一模一样。（as identical as …）
到了 1984 年，规划报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件一模一样的东西。（something identical）
answers: In 1977 the planner wrote of an identical copy of the key in the report.
It was so identical that nobody in the district would go near it.
My mother thought it too identical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an identical twin in the photograph.
He said nobody would call it as identical as the twin in the photograph they had once had.
By 1984 the report asked for nothing but something identical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 identical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the planner wrote of an identical copy of the key in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the identical copy of the key that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too identical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an identical twin in the photograph, and nobody argued with him.
The citizen from the next district called the plan quite identical, and everybody laughed.
The identical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
